notes.title: DeadCore Redux at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p][b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is starting today and we wanted to let you know that [b]DeadCore Redux[/b] will be there with an [b]updated demo[/b]!

Thanks to your feedback - big up to [b]Plasmawario[/b], [b]Reherc Fox[/b] and [b]neon-nn7lr[/b] for their detailed input! - we worked on a few [b]quality of life improvements[/b] to make the demo even better. [/p][p]
It’s still work in progress and most of the following changes will probably evolve until the final version but here is a quick [b]changelog[/b] of this new demo: 
[/p][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tweaked Turrets colors when switching states[/p][/*][*][p]Added shortcut (remappable - on hold) to restart a level 
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Menus / UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]New title screen and overall menus structure / wording (ex.: “Story” -> “Cycle”)[/p][/*][*][p]New (WiP) tutorial pop-ups videos at the end of Level01 to introduce Dash and Sparks[/p][/*][*][p]Added audio + VFX to Rank screen[/p][/*][*][p]New ranks wording based on game’s lore:  Novice < Apprentice < Runner < Transmitter < Forerunner[/p][/*][*][p]BugFix: fixed typos in Settings, Boosts, and Whispers[/p][/*][*][p]BugFix: fixed controls mapping not saved + several small bugs 
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Better audio mix[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to boost master volume [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484260/DeadCore_Redux/"][/dynamiclink]Like always, we are looking forward to hearing your feedback on these changes so don’t hesitate to stop by the Steam forums to let us know what you think about it. [/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p] [/p][p]Studio 5 Bits Game[/p]

notes.title: DeadCore Redux: Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hello there,

We are very happy to announce that [b]DeadCore Redux demo[/b] is now available!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=04RfJzaW83Q

It has been crafted to be released for the AG French Direct event, celebrating french indie devs and broadcasting live on May, 28 at 6PM UTC+2:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_mJfGPdssCU

This demo will let you (re)discover “The Fall” ([b]Story Level #1[/b]) as it’s supposed to be played the first time you launch the game, then a second time with the [b]Dash ability[/b] (normally unlocked in Story Level #3).

The Dash has always been one of the main components of the game as it allows for experimenting with new ways to navigate levels, letting players find new shortcuts and collectibles: we hope you will like the freedom it provides and, for veteran players, its brand new sound design!

Speaking of collectibles, you’ll be able to find [b]2 Sparks[/b] in The Fall. 
Sadly, most players didn’t notice in the original game, but finding these collectibles unlock their corresponding [b]Spark Level[/b] in Speedrun mode where you can compete with other players on online leaderboards.


The demo features the 2 first Sparks Levels - “The Rim” and “The System” - for you to try them offline in order to sharpen your skills before the game release : )

Additionally, there are also a couple more features available in this build in a very [b]work in progress[/b] state, like:
[list]
[*]Early [b]Steam Deck[/b] support (select “Steamdeck” in quality settings for 60fps)
[*]Settings menu 1st draft (more options to come like HDR screens support)
[/list]

We are also still looking into implementing additional accessibility options based on feedback from players (thanks ViRiXDreamcore!).

We hope you will enjoy the demo and as always, feel free to reach out if you have any feedback for us!

Cheers,

5 Bits Games

notes.title: DeadCore Redux Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

So, it has been a long time since we last communicated about the game - well, 10 years is definitely a long time… ^^’ - and today we wanted to share with you some great news.

After spending 10+ years working for different game studios, team 5 Bits Games members are joining forces again to make new games and, as as way to get back in the saddle, we spent the past year working on DeadCore Redux, a remaster of our game DeadCore released in 2014.

Making DeadCore Redux is not only a way for us to learn again to work as a team, but also the opportunity to get the extra polish time we missed back in 2014 and to address the issues reported by the community.

This new version features many cool things, like revamped graphics and audio, gamepads support and a brand new Story level, and we really hope people will like it.

Speaking of which, the Steam page is now online there: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484260/DeadCore_Redux/]DeadCore Redux[/url]

We invite you to take a look at it for more details about what’s coming and if you want to support us in the meantime, well, you can wishlist it, it would definitely help us a great deal! (especially now that we are self publishing the game : p)

If you’re curious about this enhanced version you can check the short teaser we released:
[previewyoutube=Zj9p5cCY3G8;full][/previewyoutube]

To be fully transparent with you, we are currently looking for a way to offer a special discount on the Redux version to DeadCore owners but we haven’t found a solution yet.

Anyway, stay tuned as we will post updates regarding these topics in the upcoming weeks and will release a demo version within the next month.

Have a great day!

Team 5 Bits Games.

P.S.: By the way, you can now find us on BlueSky: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/5bitsgames.com]@5bitsgames.com[/url]

notes.title: DeadCore Patch 02 - [EN - FR]
notes.content:
----------------------------------------------------
[English Version - French following]

Hey everyone!

We know it's been a long time since DeadCore last update but all the team members had to deal with their daily jobs (and sometime rush periods) before being able to find the time required to work on the game.

So let's get to the point: we are currently in the process of uploading a new version and if everything goes fine (yup, there's always a "if" ^^) it should be available today!

This update brings its share of bug fixes and tweaks, like the "Gravity Box exploit" or the support of higher (and fancier) screen resolutions. 

You will find more details in the upcoming release note but another important news is that we will have to reset the current leaderboards to make it fair for everyone, especially new players.

We hope this update will provide you a better speedrunning experience and we are looking forward to seeing you reaching the top of the new leaderboards!

See you,

Team 5 Bits games

[French Version]

Salut tout le monde !

Nous sommes conscients que la dernière mise-à-jour commence à dater mais tous les membres de l'équipe ont d'abord du gérer leurs jobs actuels (et parfois avec les periodes de rush associées), avant d'avoir le temps nécessaire pour travailler sur DeadCore.

Mais allons droit au but: nous sommes actuellement en train de mettre en ligne une nouvelle version et si tout se passe bien (yep, il y a toujours un "si" ^^), elle devrait être disponible aujourd'hui !

Cette mise-à-jour apporte son lot de corrections de bugs et d'améliorations, telles que "l'exploit des Boites de Gravité" ou bien le support de résolutions d'écran supérieures.

Vous trouverez plus de details dans la note qui viendra avec la mise-à-jour mais quoi qu'il en soit, l'autre information importante c'est que nous allons à nouveau réinitialiser les classements en ligne afin que la compétition reste équitable, notamment pour les nouveaux joueurs.

Nous espérons que cette mise-à-jour vous apportera une meilleure expérience de speedrunning et nous sommes impatients de vous voir prendre la tête de ces nouveaux classements en ligne !

A bientôt,

L'équipe de 5 Bits Games
--------------------------------------------------

notes.title: DeadCore Patch 01 - [EN - FR]
notes.content:
EN

Hi everyone!

Here we are: the patch fixing the 'Blast Climbing' is now tested, approved and ready to be torn apart by you people : )

After discussing with players very active on the Steam forums we decided to reset the leaderboards as they were full of times made using the exploit: it means that the new leaderboards are now blank, you should hurry for the first place!

But don't worry, we also kept the old leaderboards in a separate branch called 'deadcore_1.0', along with DeadCore version 1.0 (the one that sill feature the 'Blast Climbing' exploit).

To get access to this, you will have to turn your current branch of DeadCore to the 'deadcore1.0' one, by right-clicking on the game name (in your Steam Library), then click on 'properties'. Then click on the BETA tab and select ‘deadcore_1.0’ in the list and wait a little bit for the download. That’s it!

This way everyone will be able to choose their own version of the game / leaderboards to compete online!

As for the new version, here is a list of the changes we made :
Programming:
Fixed 'Blast Climbing' exploit
User can now bind 'Shift' key in Settings menu
[Linux] Fixed a bug that made the game crash at the end of a level

Level Design:
Level 4: fixed checkpoint issue (left path) + minor tweaks
Level 5: minor fixes / tweaks

That's all folks: we hope you will enjoy the small improvements we made to the game and we are looking forward to hearing your feedback on the Steam forums!

See you,

Team 5 Bits Games


FR

Salut tout le monde!

Ça y est : le patch réglant l'exploit du 'Blast Climbing' est à présent testé, approuvé et prêt à se faire mettre en pièces par vos petites mains : )

Après avoir discuté avec des joueurs très actifs sur les forums Steam, nous avons décidé de remettre à 0 les classements en ligne car ils étaient remplis de temps réalisés grâce à l'exploit du Blast : cela veut dire que les nouveaux classements en lignes sont vierges et que vous devriez vous dépêcher d'aller prendre la première place !

Mais pas d'inquiétude, nous avons également gardé les anciens classements en ligne dans une branche séparée nommée 'deadcore_1.0', avec la version 1.0 de DeadCore (celle contenant l'exploit du 'Blast Climbing').

Pour y avoir accès à cette branche il vous suffit de faire clic-roit sur le nom du jeu (dans votre Bibliothèque Steam), puis cliquer sur 'Propriétés'. Dans la nouvelle fenêtre, cliquez sur l'onglet BETA, puis choisissez "deadcore_1.0" dans la liste déroulante. Voilà c'est tout !

De cette manière tout le monde sera capable de choisir sa propre version du jeu et des classements en ligne sur lesquels s'affronter en ligne !

Pour ce qui est de la nouvelle version, voici la liste des changements effectués :
Programmation:
Fixé l'exploit du 'Blast Climbing'		
L'utilisateur peut à présent configurer la touche 'Shift' dans le menu Options	
[Linux] Fixé le bug faissant crasher le jeu à la fin d'un niveau	

Level Design:
Level 4: fixé le bug de sauvegarde lié à un checkpoint (chemin de gauche) + améliorations mineures		
Level 5: correctifs / améliorations mineures

Voilà c'est à peu près tout : nous espérons que vous apprécierez les améliorations apportées au jeu et on hâte de lire vos avis sur les forums Steam !

A bientôt,

L'équipe de 5 Bits Games

notes.title: Impressions: DeadCore
notes.content:
DeadCore snuck up from nowhere. A complete FPS platformer, out on Steam tomorrow, whose terrible name belies a swishy, entertaining and rather tricky game. There’s is no shortage of FPS platform jumping of late, so does DeadCore do enough to stand out?

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Steam keys for Alpha backers
notes.content:
To our alpha backers,

Hey everyone!

Sorry for the long delay, but here we are: you are going to receive your Steam key as promised.

We are really grateful for your support during the development, we wouldn't have been able to bring the game that far if you hadn't fueled our motivation all along the way.

Due to some technical difficulties (and chaotic organization let's face it...), we need you to send us a mail to [b][u]deadcore.alpha@gmail.com[/u][/b] with the following info:
[list]
[*][b][DeadCore-Alpha-Desura-Steam-Key][/b] as the mail subject (you just have to copy-paste it)
[*]Your Desura user name (aka: your public nickname)
[*]Your Desura key of DeadCore
[/list]
Please, note that we need a valid mail address to send you back a Steam key: do not use temporary free mailing services as you may never receive our mail with the key.

Once we receive your mail, we send you a Steam key and that's it : )

Again, we want to thank you for help and feedback during those 2 long years, thanks to you we can be proud of what we have achieved as a team.

We also hope you will enjoy playing DeadCore!

See you soon,

Team 5 Bits Games.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - DeadCore
notes.content:
DeadCore is Now Available on Steam!

DeadCore is a Platformer-FPS blending exploration and speedrun.

Become immersed in a futuristic and dreamlike adventure which will see you climb a huge Tower born from the void and truly put your capabilities to the test. Will you be able to reveal the secrets that lie beneath this fog-ridden world?

notes.title: DEADCORE AVAILABLE NOW ON PC, MAC AND LINUX
notes.content:
The independent studio 5 Bits Games and BANDAI NAMCO Games Europe S.A.S. proudly announce the release of DEADCORE! 

This Platformer-FPS set in a mysterious futuristic world combines exploration, puzzle and speedrun tactics. 
After an endless fall through powerful magnetic storms... you awaken. Your memory erased, you start exploring the world around you. Someone or something is pushing you higher and higher. Suddenly, you spot the most gigantic Tower emerging from the mists. You soon understand that to get the answers to your questions... you have to climb its summit. Use your skills and your SwitchGun to survive the security system of the Tower in staggering levels and labyrinths.
Will you be able to reveal the secrets that lie beneath this fog-ridden world?
